v.rationale: impl-2 ranks first. Every schedule is pinned to Copenhagen time, runs on one server and uses short-expiry overlap locks, and the job has unique/timeout/retry settings in a sensible order. Its tests are the most thorough (DST, boundaries, a real database-queue uniqueness check); the only weakness is a two-server test that would pass even without onOneServer. impl-3 has nearly the same design and even cleaner job timing, but runs the prune in UTC and has weaker tests (an expect(true) filler and a misleadingly named test). impl-1 has the best prune loop and broad tests, but its UniqueFor equals the hourly interval, and a probe confirmed this can drop the next hourly sync after a crash, which is the exact failure the brief forbids. It also edited the committed .env and has a test asserting withoutOverlapping is never used, based on a misreading of how its lock expires.
